policy.rule: Published external results remain precise explicit parameters; no proof of the external exponent is claimed.

principal_external_inputs.source_title: Error exponent of activated non-signaling assisted classical-quantum channel coding
principal_external_inputs.published_hypotheses: Finite classical-quantum channel with finite-dimensional density outputs; the nontrivial exponent regime is C0(W)<r<C(W). The propositions give matching asymptotic bounds and hence an ordinary limit. The source uses natural logarithms.
principal_external_inputs.exact_specialized_input: For every n,d : Nat, every actual CQChannel W n d with FullRank W, and every real r with 0<r<holevoCapacity W: Tendsto (fun k : Nat => -(1/(k:Real))*log2(epsMC(tensorPowerFamily W k)(2^((k:Real)*r)))) atTop (nhds(spherePacking W r)).
principal_external_inputs.unit_conversion: Take the published natural-log rate to be r*log(2), so exp(k*r*log(2))=2^(k*r). Divide the natural-log exponent and capacity units by log(2); the Petz divergences and sphere-packing formula become the project's base-two quantities, exactly P22 Eq23.
applicability_checks: Actual CQChannel consists of PSD trace-one complex matrices; tensorPowerFamily is the genuine iterated Kronecker channel with explicit finite-index relabeling.
Full rank is the project's actual positive definiteness, not an abstract error-sequence hypothesis.
P22 internally proves orderAlphaCapacity_tendsto_zero and orderAlphaCapacityExtended_tendsto_zero for full-rank outputs, giving C0(W)=0 and the published admissible rate interval 0<r<C(W).

The source SDP uses Lambda_x=M*q_x*T_x and p_x=M*q_x; the project uses S_x=q_x*T_x. Dividing the source normalization by M gives sum S_x<=I/M and S_x<=q_x I. ProgramsSDP proves the actual q,T <-> q,S substitution and identical error objective.
Full-rank block errors at every real L>1 are proved positive internally, including the original-lambda lower bound; total Real.log at zero does not affect the relevant tail.
The source ordinary MC limit is the input; exact ceil message counts, +6 slack, arbitrary rate sequences, NS/ANS transfer, and EReal zero-error semantics are all internally proved.
principal_external_inputs.missing_formalization: A closed Lean proof constructing ExternalMetaConverseLimit. This is a disclosed published external theorem, retained as a parameter. Internal partial reproofs of testing, SDP duality, moments and capacity optimization remain compiled but are not substituted for this limit.
principal_external_inputs.dependency_closure_note: The final theorem has a hypothesis, not a sorryAx/custom axiom dependency. The production proof closure is audited under the standard three axioms only.

disclosed_unformalized_properties: Standard continuity of the order-alpha/Augustin capacity at alpha=1 with Holevo endpoint
General possibly-singular-channel extended-real optimization attainment beyond the full-rank case
